name: Action Fox
summary: One of my larger projects that I spent some time in over the Summer working on. The player was given a semi complicated animation system, an enemy system that allowed for easily developing future enemies in a lego like module system, a camera that properly animates based on the player and environments around them, and a complicated menu system.

name: 1984 GameMaker Game
summary: A school project made in GameMaker that I made within the spand of a week. The directions of the project werent directly for making a video game, but the teacher still graded it highly since it fit within the criteria of asking trivia about the book! The graphics were basic and quickly done on a touchpad but was my first time trying to handle a 'complicated' scoring system and a basic risk v reward system
